about: Sample catalog for caelitus: real books with the year of first publication (stored as 1 January; exact days are often unknown). No ISBNs or page counts: they differ per edition. Titles are in the language given by "language". Reviews are made up. Used by web/scripts/seed.ts and db/sample/build.sh.
